h1: Restaurant marketing in Brickell & Downtown Miami
answer: Button Up Media is a Miami restaurant marketing agency that helps Brickell and Downtown restaurants fill lunch, happy hour and weeknight tables with social video, Google search, websites and ads.
heroSub: Our social work for Shimuja Ramen at Julia & Henry's on Flagler St adds up to 15.4M views. Here is how we would approach your restaurant.

market.h2: Dense, fast and busy from lunch to last call
paragraphsHtml: Brickell and Downtown pack a lot of restaurants, bars and food halls into a few walkable blocks. Your competition is not just next door. It is the rooftop across the street and the new opening down the block, all on the same phone screen.

The day runs in shifts. Weekdays bring a lunch rush from the office towers, then an after-work crowd deciding on the fly. Evenings and weekends belong to the people who live in the condo towers, plus hotel guests and visitors looking for something close.
Spanish is everywhere here, from long-time Miami families to Latin American professionals and visitors. Marketing that only speaks English skips a big part of your own block.

needs.h2: What works in Brickell and Downtown

items.title: Own a time slot
items.body: Pick the shifts you want to win, like weekday lunch or happy hour, and market them on purpose: the right post, Google update and ad at the right hour, not a generic feed.

items.title: Be ready for the five-minute decision
items.body: People here often choose where to eat minutes before they walk in. Your Google profile, photos and reviews have to make the case fast, with directions and booking one tap away.

items.title: Stay fresh against new openings
items.body: New concepts open all the time. A steady flow of new video and photos keeps you in the conversation, so the newest place on the block does not take your regulars.

items.title: Speak to the whole block
items.body: Bilingual posts, ads and review replies reach Spanish-speaking residents, professionals and visitors along with everyone else.

proof.h2: Work downtown and across the bay

items.body: A ramen shop that started in Southwest Ranches, ran a pop-up at Baby Jane in Brickell and now serves at Julia & Henry's food hall on Flagler St.
Waterfront dining across the Rickenbacker Causeway. In 2025, Google Ads drove 1,007 conversions worth $135K at $18.95 each, including 155 on Mother's Day at $3.06 each.

plan.h2: What we would do for a Brickell or Downtown restaurant

items.title: Show up for "near me" and "Brickell" searches
items.bodyHtml: We tune your Google Business Profile, categories, photos and reviews so you appear when someone nearby searches for lunch, drinks or dinner. Our restaurant SEO and Google Business Profile service covers the details.

items.title: Content as sharp as the skyline
items.bodyHtml: Our crew shoots at your restaurant, then we post Reels and TikToks in English and Spanish that show the food, the room and the view. See our social media and content service.

items.title: Ads timed to lunch and happy hour
items.bodyHtml: We run Google and Meta ads aimed at people a few blocks away, on the days and hours that matter, with every reservation and call tracked. It is the same work behind Rusty Pelican's 7:1 return.

items.title: A site that books in one tap
items.bodyHtml: If your menu is a slow PDF or the booking link breaks, the next place gets the table. We build custom, mobile-first restaurant websites in English and Spanish.

shoots.h2: How shoots work in Brickell and Downtown
shoots.body: We come to you. Our own in-house crew shoots photo and video at your restaurant, and one shoot typically gives us 4 to 6 weeks of content. We plan the shot list with you and work around your lunch and happy hour rush so service keeps moving. If you are inside a tower, hotel or shopping center, we check any filming rules with you before shoot day.

pricing.bodyHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 per month for a coordinated program across social, search and ads. Website builds are one-time: $1,500 for a Website Build or $2,000 for an Integrated Website Build. Ad management has no long-term contract. On a free call we will tell you which pieces you need first.

faqs.q: Can you fill a slow weekday lunch or happy hour?
faqs.a: Yes. We line up Google updates, posts and targeted ads for the hours you want to fill, then track the calls, bookings and orders that come in.
